comments.author: bakabaka
comments.body:
ONCE YOU MEET CERTAIN CONDITIONS, YOU WILL GAIN A REVELATION THROUGH
THE "BOOK OF WISDOM" AND BE ABLE TO USE "SOPHIA AWAKENING."

What conditions would it be?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
1. Complete this quest: Egypt and Atlantis
2. Install one of the following furniture items in your Quarters: Transmutation Alchemy Equipment / Complex Alchemy Equipment

Transmutation alchemy becomes available to use. Most recipes appear if you have the BASE item in your inventory; certain Legacy recipes (Calculator and Aroma) require you to make a discovery before the recipe appears. All Legacy recipes require Sophia points in addition to the listed items.

Cheers.
